title: The connecting map for a chosen polynomial presentation is exact and differentiates coefficients
statement: Let $R\to S\to T$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings. Choose surjective polynomial presentations $P:R[X_\sigma]\to S$ and $Q:S[Y_\iota]\to T$ with sections [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Put $J=\ker Q$, $H_Q=\ker(J/J^2\to T\otimes_{S[Y]}\Omega_{S[Y]/S})$, with conormal differential $[g]\mapsto1\otimes\mathrm dg$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. The presentation-level Jacobi-Zariski connecting map $\delta_{Q,P}:H_Q\to T\otimes_S\Omega_{S/R}$ has image the kernel of $w:T\otimes_S\Omega_{S/R}\to\Omega_{T/R}$, $w(t\otimes\mathrm ds)=t\,\mathrm d(s\cdot1_T)$. Define $c_Q:S[Y]\to T\otimes_S\Omega_{S/R}$ by $c_Q(\sum_\alpha b_\alpha Y^\alpha)=\sum_\alpha Q(Y^\alpha)\otimes\mathrm db_\alpha$. For $g\in J$ whose conormal class is a cycle, $\delta_{Q,P}([g])=c_Q(g)$. In particular $c_Q(bY^\alpha)=Q(Y^\alpha)\otimes\mathrm db$, $c_Q(b)=1\otimes\mathrm db$, and $c_Q(fg)=Q(f)c_Q(g)+Q(g)c_Q(f)$ for all $f,g\in S[Y]$.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib Algebra.Generators.H1Cotangent.exact_δ_map to Q and P for exactness. Its δ_eq_δAux identifies the connecting map on each cycle represented by g. The coefficient map is δAux; its monomial and constant formulas are δAux_monomial and δAux_C, and its product formula is δAux_mul. These are exactly the stated clauses, with no flatness, finite-type or smoothness assumption.
